articles.title: Samsung Expands Galaxy Buds Family with First Open-Ear Clip Design
articles.description: Samsung Electronics has introduced the Galaxy Buds On, its first ear-clip wireless earbuds, extending the Galaxy Buds portfolio into the rapidly expanding open-ear category. The new design combines a TwinBoost Speaker system with audio leakage reduction, automatic volume adjustment, three microphones and bone-conduction voice sensing, while adopting Qualcomm’s Snapdragon S7 Gen 1 Sound Platform to support advanced processing and extended battery operation.
